item.title: Drake’s Sound Engineer OVO Noel Reveals Original ‘ICEMAN,’ ‘MAID OF HONOUR’ & ‘HABIBTI’ Tracklists
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music update. We're talking about the one and only Drake, who's been dominating the Billboard charts for three weeks now with his triple album release: ICEMAN, HABIBTI, and MAID OF HONOUR.
[Short music transition]
Host: Drake's sound engineer, Noel, recently gave fans a behind-the-scenes look at the creative process, sharing the original tracklists for each album. And what's interesting is that ICEMAN's tracklist remained pretty much unchanged from its final version. However, we did learn that the hit single "Janice STFU" was originally just "Janice", and another track, "Firm Friends", might have been renamed from "Can't Play Switzerland".
[Short music transition]
Host: The other two albums, HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR, had some changes. HABIBTI swapped out "Vital" for "Classic", and "I'm Spent" featuring Loe Shimmy was a late addition to the project. Diehard fans might remember "Vital" from Drake's 2017 Boy Meets World Tour in New Zealand, which eventually leaked online in 2020 but never got an official release.
[Short music transition]
Host: So, how are the albums performing? Well, ICEMAN is still on top of the Billboard 200, earning 225,000 equivalent album units in the US. And "Janice STFU" is still at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, giving Drake his 14th Hot 100 number one single, breaking a tie with Michael Jackson for the most among male soloists.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in to the latest music update. We'll keep you posted on more news and updates from the world of music.
